hook: Isolated rain till *Nov 27*, then a cold spell
hook_b: Isolated rain till *Nov 27*, then a cold spell
tldr: IMD Hyderabad predicts light to moderate rain over two days followed by dry weather, with misty mornings.

beats.what: Southern and central Telangana, including Hyderabad, could see isolated rain from November 25 to 27.
beats.why: IMD says partly cloudy skies and hazy morning conditions will persist due to the rain effect.
beats.care: Expect hazy early commutes now and colder nights from the weekend.

cards.title: 🆕 Midday update
cards.body: No rain in the city till noon Wednesday. IMD forecast cloudy skies turning partly cloudy by evening, with no rain for Hyderabad today.

qs: How cold could nights get during the Nov 29-Dec 4 spell?

facts.t: IMD predicts light to moderate rain for *two days*, then dry weather.
Till 11 am Wednesday, *3.8 mm* rain fell in Kamkole (Sangareddy) and Gunegal (Rangareddy).

viz.verdict: Forecasts from IMD and Telangana Weatherman.
Districts are far colder than the city for now.

sources.title: Cloudy Wednesday for Hyderabad; rain recorded in few parts of Rangareddy, Sangareddy

fact: Cloudy but dry Hyderabad Wednesday; only *3.8 mm* fell in Sangareddy, Rangareddy
twist: Hyderabad's low was *22.5°C*, while Asifabad dipped to *15.6°C*; a cold spell is forecast from *Nov 29*.
